author: Parent · Class X, State Board batch
text: What changed for us was the weekly test report on WhatsApp — we always knew exactly where our daughter stood, long before the actual exam.

author: Parent · NDA aspirant
text: The NDA batch is run like an actual mission — syllabus, mocks, mentorship, all on schedule. My son finally has a routine he sticks to.

author: Student · XII Science, NEET track
text: Small batches made the difference. The faculty actually knew which topics I was weak in, and we fixed those first.

author: Parent · Merchant Navy aspirant
text: We hadn't even heard of IMU-CET properly before this. The counselling session alone was worth joining for.
